papers.title: Imaginative Perception Tokens Enhance Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal Language Models
papers.what: Trains a vision-language model to emit perceptual intermediate representations of unseen viewpoints; on Multiview Counting it gains 3.4 percent and beats textual chain-of-thought, which can hurt.

papers.title: VAN-AD: Visual Masked Autoencoder with Normalizing Flow for Time Series Anomaly Detection
papers.what: Ports masked-autoencoder reconstruction to time-series anomaly detection and adds a normalizing-flow density head so the anomaly score is a calibrated likelihood, not a raw error.

papers.title: On Information Self-Locking in Reinforcement Learning for Active Reasoning of LLM Agents
papers.what: Names a training trap where a question-asking agent stops exploring, traces it to coupled action-selection and belief-tracking weakness, and breaks it with cheap directional critiques.

papers.title: Agent Memory: Characterization and System Implications of Stateful Long-Horizon Workloads
papers.what: Profiles agent-memory patterns (flat retrieval, LLM extraction, fact stores, agentic control) at runtime to show which are expensive to serve at scale.
